title: ROSE Doesn’t Do That: Boosting the Safety of Instruction-Tuned Large Language Models with Reverse Prompt Contrastive Decoding
reasoning: The paper benchmarks LLM safety across several categories including 'Ethics and Morality' (EM) and 'Unfairness and Bias' (UB). It also utilizes prompts that explicitly mention religious and moral constraints to test and improve model safety through reverse prompt contrastive decoding.
